shot_variations.frontal-1: Centered frontal master, neutral expression, soft even studio illumination.
shot_variations.frontal-2: Centered frontal variant, neutral expression, warmer illumination and slightly farther camera distance.
shot_variations.left-1: Head approximately 25 degrees left, neutral expression, soft even daylight.
shot_variations.left-2: Head approximately 35 degrees left, neutral expression, cooler side illumination.
shot_variations.right-1: Head approximately 25 degrees right, neutral expression, soft even daylight.
shot_variations.right-2: Head approximately 35 degrees right, neutral expression, warmer side illumination.
shot_variations.probe-1: Frontal probe with subtle expression or distance variation.
shot_variations.probe-2: Approximately 18 to 20 degrees left with warm side illumination.
shot_variations.probe-3: Approximately 18 to 20 degrees right with a small chin-angle change and cool side illumination.

controls.no-face: Empty gray studio backdrop with an unoccupied stool and no person or face.
controls.two-faces: Exactly two distinct fictional adults, side by side, both faces unobstructed.
controls.blurred-face: One fictional adult with severe horizontal camera-motion blur.
controls.dark-face: One fictional adult severely underexposed with facial details mostly lost in shadow.

shared_constraints: Photorealistic fictional adults only; neutral studio backgrounds; no celebrity or public-figure resemblance; no names, text, logos, watermarks, accessories, or downloaded real-person photographs. Identity-preserving variants use only that identity's generated master as their image reference.
